# Dungeon Totems of Undying

![Dungeon Totems of Undying](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/dungeon-totems-of-undying.gif)

A new set of 19 totems can now be found along the train. Custom made for this modpack. They will still save your life, mostly...

Some might turn you against your friends, others may turn you into a cow, wolf, llama or more. Some might have you think zombification is better than death... if you can turn back.

What else awaits after these totems? The train has the answers.

*Shout out to Lil Detective Crunch (mc: AntonioMacarely) for the idea and help designing this addition to the pack.*

Will [AshSeven](https://twitch.tv/ashseven7) be the first to get the Everything Burrito advancement, completing every other advancement in the game? Join his livestream on [Twitch](https://twitch.tv/ashseven7) at <t:1794697200:F> (Saturday 14 November, 23:00 UTC).

![The Drifting Engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/the-drifting-engine.gif)

![Free Live Eye translations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/free-live-eye-translations.jpg)
